notes: Single source of truth for user-facing vocabulary. The UI, the API and the tests all read this file, so a term cannot be explained one way in the interface and another way in a report. Chinese first because the primary users are China-based field representatives; English is kept for reviewers and auditors working in English.

zh-CN.label: 不良事件（AE）
zh-CN.plain: 患者用药后出现的任何不舒服，不管是否确定跟药有关，都需要上报。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 公司有法定义务收集并上报，漏报是合规事故。

en.label: Adverse event (AE)
en.plain: Any unwanted experience a patient has after taking the product, whether or not it is known to be caused by it.
en.why_it_matters: Collection and reporting are legal obligations; a missed report is a compliance failure.

zh-CN.label: 严重不良事件（SAE）
zh-CN.plain: 导致住院、危及生命、致残或死亡等严重后果的不良事件，上报时限更紧。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 属于加速上报范围，时限以天计算。

en.label: Serious adverse event (SAE)
en.plain: An adverse event that leads to hospitalisation, disability, a life-threatening situation, or death.
en.why_it_matters: Falls under expedited reporting; the clock is counted in days.

zh-CN.label: 超适应症（Off-label）
zh-CN.plain: 把药说成能治说明书里没批准的病、人群或用法。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 推广未获批用法属于违规推广，公司和个人都可能被追责。

en.label: Off-label
en.plain: Describing the product as treating a disease, population, or usage that the approved label does not cover.
en.why_it_matters: Promoting unapproved use is a regulatory violation for both the company and the individual.

zh-CN.label: 个人敏感信息（PII）
zh-CN.plain: 能定位到具体某个人的信息，比如姓名、电话、病历号。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 这类信息不能直接进入模型或外发，必须先替换成代号。

en.label: Personal identifiable information (PII)
en.plain: Information that can point to one specific person, such as a name, phone number, or medical record number.
en.why_it_matters: It must be replaced with a token before it reaches a model or leaves the system.

zh-CN.label: 健康相关个人信息（PHI）
zh-CN.plain: 与某个人健康状况相关、且能定位到这个人的信息。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 敏感度高于一般个人信息，处理要求更严。

en.label: Protected health information (PHI)
en.plain: Health information that can be linked back to one identifiable person.
en.why_it_matters: More sensitive than ordinary personal data and handled under stricter rules.

zh-CN.label: 假名化（脱敏）
zh-CN.plain: 把姓名替换成固定代号，代号与真名分开保管，需要授权才能还原。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 同一个人始终对应同一个代号，既保护隐私又不影响分析。

en.label: Pseudonymisation
en.plain: Replacing a name with a stable token, keeping the mapping separately and releasing it only to authorised roles.
en.why_it_matters: One person keeps one token, so privacy is protected without losing analytical continuity.

zh-CN.label: 个例安全报告（ICSR）
zh-CN.plain: 一份可上报的安全报告，需要「患者、报告人、可疑药品、不良反应」四要素齐全。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 四要素缺一项就不构成有效报告，需要补齐后才能上报。

en.label: Individual case safety report (ICSR)
en.plain: A reportable safety report, valid only when all four elements are present: patient, reporter, suspect product, and reaction.
en.why_it_matters: Missing any one element means the report is not yet valid and follow-up is required.

zh-CN.label: 合规红线
zh-CN.plain: 绝对不能出现的行为描述，比如利益输送、不当对比。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 属于零容忍范围，会被直接拦下。

en.label: Compliance redline
en.plain: Conduct that is never acceptable, such as inducement or improper comparison.
en.why_it_matters: Zero tolerance: content describing it is blocked outright.

zh-CN.label: 提示注入
zh-CN.plain: 内容里夹带了想指挥 AI 的话，比如「忽略之前的规则」。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 系统只把内容当资料读，不当指令执行，但这种尝试会被记录。

en.label: Prompt injection
en.plain: Text that tries to give the AI instructions, such as "ignore the previous rules".
en.why_it_matters: Content is always read as data, never executed as instructions, and the attempt is recorded.

zh-CN.label: 证据包
zh-CN.plain: 系统为这次判断实际查到的资料清单，每条都有编号可以核对。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 判断只能引用这里面的资料，不能凭印象下结论。

en.label: Evidence pack
en.plain: The set of records the system actually retrieved for this assessment, each with a citable id.
en.why_it_matters: Conclusions may only cite what is in the pack, never an unsupported recollection.

zh-CN.label: 审计链
zh-CN.plain: 每条记录都带上一条记录的指纹，串成一条链。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 任何人事后改动或删除记录都会断链，从而被发现。

en.label: Audit chain
en.plain: Each record carries a fingerprint of the record before it, forming a chain.
en.why_it_matters: Any later edit or deletion breaks the chain and therefore becomes detectable.

zh-CN.label: 人工复核
zh-CN.plain: 交给药物警戒、医学或合规同事看一眼再决定。
zh-CN.why_it_matters: 内容会完整保留，只是发布前需要有资质的人确认。

en.label: Human review
en.plain: A pharmacovigilance, medical, or compliance colleague looks at it before it proceeds.
en.why_it_matters: The narrative is kept in full; only publication waits for a qualified person.

zh-CN.title: 这段话提到了用药后的不舒服
zh-CN.why: 患者用药后的任何不适都属于不良事件，公司有义务上报。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 内容已完整保留，已转给药物警戒同事；如果知道发生时间和目前情况，请补充一句。

en.title: This mentions a reaction after taking the product
en.why: Any unwanted experience after use counts as an adverse event, which the company must report.
en.what_to_do: The narrative is kept in full and routed to pharmacovigilance; add the onset date and current status if you know them.

zh-CN.title: 这段话提到了严重后果
zh-CN.why: 住院、危及生命、致残或死亡属于严重不良事件，上报时限更紧。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 已按最高优先级转药物警戒，请尽快补充患者情况与发生时间。

en.title: This mentions a serious outcome
en.why: Hospitalisation, a life-threatening situation, disability, or death is a serious adverse event with a tighter deadline.
en.what_to_do: Routed to pharmacovigilance at the highest priority; please add patient status and onset time as soon as you can.

zh-CN.title: 这段话说的用法超出了说明书批准范围
zh-CN.why: 把药说成能治说明书没批准的病或人群，属于违规推广。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请改成说明书批准的表述，或删掉这部分；需要保留的话要走医学与合规复核。

en.title: This describes a use beyond the approved label
en.why: Presenting the product as treating an unapproved disease or population is promotional non-compliance.
en.what_to_do: Reword to the approved wording or remove it; keeping it requires medical and compliance review.

zh-CN.title: 这段话在推广未获批的内容
zh-CN.why: 推广没有获批的产品或用法是明确禁止的。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 这段不能这样发出去，请改写为获批表述后再提交。

en.title: This promotes something that is not approved
en.why: Promoting an unlicensed product or usage is expressly prohibited.
en.what_to_do: It cannot go out in this form; rewrite it using approved wording and resubmit.

zh-CN.title: 这段话把本品和别的治疗做了比较
zh-CN.why: 对比性说法需要有充分证据支持，否则属于不当宣传。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请去掉比较性表述，或提供可引用的研究依据交医学复核。

en.title: This compares the product with another therapy
en.why: A comparative claim needs solid supporting evidence, otherwise it is improper promotion.
en.what_to_do: Remove the comparison, or supply a citable study for medical review.

zh-CN.title: 这段话涉及利益输送
zh-CN.why: 宴请、礼品、回扣等描述属于合规红线，零容忍。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 这段不能发出去。如果是记录客户提出的要求，请如实描述并转合规处理。

en.title: This involves an improper benefit
en.why: Hospitality, gifts, or rebates fall on a zero-tolerance redline.
en.what_to_do: It cannot be submitted. If you are recording a request made to you, describe it factually and route it to compliance.

zh-CN.title: 这段话里有能认出具体某个人的信息
zh-CN.why: 姓名、电话这类信息不能直接进入模型，需要先替换成代号。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 系统已自动替换成代号，你不需要手动删；原文完整保留在记录里。

en.title: This contains information that identifies a specific person
en.why: Names and phone numbers must be replaced with tokens before reaching a model.
en.what_to_do: Already replaced automatically; nothing to delete by hand, and the original stays in the record.

zh-CN.title: 这段话里有健康相关的个人信息
zh-CN.why: 健康信息比一般个人信息更敏感，处理要求更严。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 系统已自动脱敏；如非必要，避免写入具体身份信息。

en.title: This contains health information about an identifiable person
en.why: Health data is more sensitive than ordinary personal data and handled under stricter rules.
en.what_to_do: Already masked automatically; avoid writing identifying details unless they are necessary.

zh-CN.title: 这段话里有大量个人身份信息
zh-CN.why: 集中出现的身份信息一旦外流影响很大，属于最高风险。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 已拦下并通知安全同事，请确认是否确实需要记录这些信息。

en.title: This contains a concentration of personal identifiers
en.why: Identifiers appearing together carry the highest impact if they leak.
en.what_to_do: Blocked and routed to security; please confirm whether these details need recording at all.

zh-CN.title: 这段话里有想指挥 AI 的指令
zh-CN.why: 系统只把内容当资料读，但这类尝试必须留痕。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 如果是客户原话，请照实记录并说明背景；已通知安全同事。

en.title: This contains text aimed at instructing the AI
en.why: Content is only ever read as data, but such attempts must leave a trace.
en.what_to_do: If a customer said it, record it verbatim with context; security has been notified.

zh-CN.title: 分不清这里说的是哪一位
zh-CN.why: 同姓的两位医生出现在同一段话里，系统不敢猜，猜错会把观点安到别人头上。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请补充说明分别是哪位医生，比如加上科室或全名。

en.title: It is unclear which person is meant
en.why: Two people share a surname in one narrative; guessing would attribute one person's view to another.
en.what_to_do: Clarify who is who, for example by adding the department or the full name.

zh-CN.title: 你填的适应症和正文说的不一致
zh-CN.why: 表单填的和正文描述不同，可能是填错了，也可能漏掉了正文里的风险。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请确认哪一个是准确的，然后修正后重新提交。

en.title: The indication you selected does not match the narrative
en.why: The form and the text disagree, which may be a form error or a risk the form hides.
en.what_to_do: Confirm which one is accurate, correct it, and resubmit.

zh-CN.title: 没认出这里说的是哪个适应症
zh-CN.why: 适应症库里没有匹配的说法，系统不猜，以免误判成超适应症。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请用说明书里的适应症名称重写，或说明具体指的是哪种情况。

en.title: The indication could not be identified
en.why: No matching concept was found, and guessing risks a wrong off-label conclusion.
en.what_to_do: Use the indication name from the label, or state which condition you mean.

zh-CN.title: 查到的资料互相矛盾
zh-CN.why: 不同版本的资料说法不一致，需要有资质的同事判断采用哪一个。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 已转医学复核，你不需要额外操作。

en.title: The retrieved records contradict each other
en.why: Different versions disagree, so a qualified colleague decides which applies.
en.what_to_do: Routed to medical review; nothing further is needed from you.

zh-CN.title: 引用的资料已经过期
zh-CN.why: 说明书或资料有版本有效期，过期版本不能作为依据。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 已转复核更新依据；如你手上有新版资料，请注明版本号。

en.title: The cited record is out of date
en.why: Labels and reference records have validity periods; an expired version cannot support a claim.
en.what_to_do: Routed for an updated reference; if you have the current version, note its number.

zh-CN.title: 没有找到支持这段话的资料
zh-CN.why: 没有依据就不能确认这段表述成立，系统不会替你假设。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请补充产品、适应症或具体用法，让系统能查到对应资料。

en.title: No supporting record was found
en.why: Without a reference the statement cannot be confirmed, and the system will not assume one.
en.what_to_do: Add the product, indication, or specific usage so the right record can be retrieved.

zh-CN.title: 还差一些信息才能判断
zh-CN.why: 缺少内容或关键对象，系统无法完成判断。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请补齐正文，或说明这次拜访涉及的对象与产品。

en.title: Some information is still missing
en.why: Without the narrative or the key parties, the assessment cannot complete.
en.what_to_do: Complete the text, or state which people and product this visit involved.

zh-CN.title: 当前角色没有这个操作权限
zh-CN.why: 该操作需要更高权限，系统不会因为界面点得到就放行。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 请联系有权限的同事处理，操作尝试已留痕。

en.title: Your role cannot perform this action
en.why: The action needs a higher permission, and a visible control never implies authorisation.
en.what_to_do: Ask an authorised colleague; the attempt has been recorded.

zh-CN.title: 这是不可撤销的写入操作
zh-CN.why: 不可撤销的操作一旦出错无法回退，必须先经人工确认。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 已拦下等待授权确认。

en.title: This is an irreversible write
en.why: An irreversible action cannot be undone if it is wrong, so it needs confirmation first.
en.what_to_do: Held pending authorised confirmation.

zh-CN.title: 发现安全相关问题
zh-CN.why: 涉及系统安全边界的情况需要安全同事处理。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 已通知安全同事，内容已保留。

en.title: A security concern was detected
en.why: Anything touching the system's trust boundary is handled by security.
en.what_to_do: Security has been notified and the content is preserved.

zh-CN.title: 格式建议
zh-CN.why: 不影响合规，只是让记录更清楚。
zh-CN.what_to_do: 可以按建议调整，也可以直接提交。

en.title: Formatting suggestion
en.why: No compliance impact; it only makes the record clearer.
en.what_to_do: Adjust if you like, or submit as is.

zh-CN.label: 可以提交
zh-CN.plain: 没有发现需要处理的问题，正常保存。

en.label: Ready to submit
en.plain: Nothing was found that needs handling.

zh-CN.label: 还差一点信息
zh-CN.plain: 有几项信息缺失，补齐后就能提交。
zh-CN.next_step: 按提示补充缺失项，然后重新检查。

en.label: A little more information needed
en.plain: A few details are missing; once added this can be submitted.
en.next_step: Fill in what is asked, then re-check.

zh-CN.label: 需要专业同事看一眼
zh-CN.plain: 内容已完整保留并进入复核队列，不会丢。
zh-CN.next_step: 无需操作，有结论会通知你；也可以在「我的记录」里跟进。

en.label: A specialist colleague needs to look
en.plain: The narrative is preserved in full and queued for review; nothing is lost.
en.next_step: No action needed; you will be notified, and you can follow it in My records.

zh-CN.label: 这段话不能这样发出去
zh-CN.plain: 命中了不能通过的红线内容。
zh-CN.next_step: 请看下面「怎么改」给出的说明；如果你认为判断有误，可以提出申诉。

en.label: This cannot go out as written
en.plain: It matches content that cannot be released.
en.next_step: See “How to fix it” below; if you believe this is wrong, you can appeal.

zh-CN.label: 无法处理这次请求
zh-CN.plain: 系统无法在安全前提下完成这次判断。
zh-CN.next_step: 内容已保留并转人工，请等待处理结果。

en.label: This request could not be processed
en.plain: The assessment could not be completed safely.
en.next_step: The content is preserved and routed to a person; please await the outcome.

zh-CN.label: 最高风险
zh-CN.plain: 必须立即处理，不能自行放行。

en.label: Highest risk
en.plain: Must be handled immediately and never self-approved.

zh-CN.label: 高风险
zh-CN.plain: 需要有资质的同事确认。

en.label: High risk
en.plain: Needs confirmation from a qualified colleague.

zh-CN.label: 中等风险
zh-CN.plain: 补齐信息或复核后可以继续。

en.label: Moderate risk
en.plain: Can proceed once information is completed or reviewed.

zh-CN.label: 低风险
zh-CN.plain: 提示性质，不阻断。

en.label: Low risk
en.plain: Advisory only; nothing is blocked.
